description: Madagascar - Annual Wind Speed is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Wind", published or maintained by KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Stockholm. Annual average wind speed (m/s) with 1km x 1km resolution. The dataset was obtained from IRENA Global Atlas for Renewable Energy ( which collects the data from the Global Wind Atlas 2.0, a free, web-based application developed, owned and operated by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) in partnership with the World Bank Group, utilizing ... Coverage: Madagascar. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Wind. The portal gives 2015 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
